name: Spectral power-law shaping and phase scramble
plain: SpectralShape tilts the whole spectrum by a power of radial frequency, optionally restoring energy. PhaseScramble randomises phase by a seeded amount along the shortest arc while keeping magnitude, which destroys structure and keeps texture stats. The radius and decompose helpers live in the missing core/freq.py, so only the node-level maths is confirmed.
math:
shape: gain=r^exponent for r>0, 1 at DC; out=real(ifftn(F·gain))
scramble: rand∈(−π,π); δ=atan2(sin(rand−P),cos(rand−P)); P′=P+δ·amount; out=recompose(M,P′)
label: from code
